quote: The alterations in mRNA levels over time were similar between the two fish for the gills and skin with increases at day 4 post-inoculation.
statement: 两种鱼在鳃和皮肤中的mRNA水平随时间的变化相似，均在接种后第4天增加。
text_zh: 两种鱼在鳃和皮肤中的mRNA水平随时间的变化相似，均在接种后第4天增加。
text_en: The changes in mRNA levels over time in the gills and skin of the two fish were similar, both increasing on day 4 post-vaccination.

quote: The Results of challenge tests (Table 3) showed that the strain has strong toxicity to crucian carp and grouper as the reference (15 , 16), the LD50 of the strain to this two species were 6.1 × 10 6 CFU/ml both calculated by R-M method.
statement: 攻毒试验结果显示该菌株对鲫鱼和石斑鱼具有强毒性，两种鱼的LD50均为6.1 × 10^6 CFU/ml。
text_zh: 攻毒试验结果显示该菌株对鲫鱼和石斑鱼具有强毒性，两种鱼的LD50均为6.1 × 10^6 CFU/ml。
text_en: Challenge test results showed that this strain is highly virulent to crucian carp and grouper, with an LD50 of 6.1 × 10^6 CFU/ml for both fish species.

quote: To demonstrate the effectiveness of the immersion vaccination, we challenged the fish by injection of inactivated V. harveyi cells at weeks 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 post–vaccination (Table 4).
statement: 为了证明浸泡疫苗的有效性，研究人员在免疫后第1至5周通过注射灭活哈维氏弧菌细胞对鱼进行攻毒挑战。
text_zh: 为了证明浸泡疫苗的有效性，研究人员在免疫后第1至5周通过注射灭活哈维氏弧菌细胞对鱼进行攻毒挑战。
text_en: To demonstrate the efficacy of the immersion vaccine, researchers challenged fish by injecting inactivated Vibrio harveyi cells from weeks 1 to 5 post-immunization.
intervention: Immersion with inactivated V. harveyi vaccine
intervention_record: 灭活哈维氏弧菌疫苗浸泡免疫
outcome: 疫苗保护效力评估方法

quote: The antibody titers in carp skin mucus peaked on day 7 and then declined and returned to pre-immunization levels by week 3.
statement: 鲤鱼皮肤黏液中的抗体滴度在第7天达到峰值，随后下降，并在第3周恢复到免疫前水平。
text_zh: 鲤鱼皮肤黏液中的抗体滴度在第7天达到峰值，随后下降，并在第3周恢复到免疫前水平。
text_en: The antibody titer in the skin mucus of common carp peaked on day 7, then declined, and returned to pre-immunization levels by week 3.

quote: In the current study, we utilized immersion vaccination of inactivated Vibrio harveyi cells for the Crucian carp (Carassius auratus) and Grouper (Epinephelus coioides) and measured alterations in antibody titers in skin mucus and serum and IgM mRNA levels in gill, skin, hindgut, liver, spleen, and head kidney (HK).
statement: 本研究利用灭活哈维氏弧菌细胞对鲫鱼和石斑鱼进行浸浴免疫，并测量皮肤黏液和血清中的抗体滴度以及鳃、皮肤、后肠、肝脏、脾脏和头肾中的IgM mRNA水平的变化。
text_zh: 本研究利用灭活哈维氏弧菌细胞对鲫鱼和石斑鱼进行浸浴免疫，并测量皮肤黏液和血清中的抗体滴度以及鳃、皮肤、后肠、肝脏、脾脏和头肾中的IgM mRNA水平的变化。
text_en: This study used inactivated Vibrio harveyi cells to perform bath immunization on crucian carp and grouper, and measured antibody titers in skin mucus and serum as well as changes in IgM mRNA levels in gills, skin, hindgut, liver, spleen, and head kidney.

quote: We also challenged the fish with live V. harveyi by injection to determine the protective effect of vaccination over time.
statement: 我们还通过注射活的哈维氏弧菌攻击鱼类，以确定疫苗随时间的保护效果。
text_zh: 我们还通过注射活的哈维氏弧菌攻击鱼类，以确定疫苗随时间的保护效果。
text_en: We also challenged fish by injecting live Vibrio harveyi to determine the protective effect of the vaccine over time.

quote: The mucosal and systemic immune responses that we measured will provide theoretical support for research and development as well as for the practical use of fish immersion vaccines.
statement: 我们测量的黏膜和全身免疫反应将为鱼类浸浴疫苗的研究开发及实际应用提供理论支持。
text_zh: 我们测量的黏膜和全身免疫反应将为鱼类浸浴疫苗的研究开发及实际应用提供理论支持。
text_en: The mucosal and systemic immune responses we measured will provide theoretical support for the research, development, and practical application of fish immersion vaccines.

quote: The fish were acclimated for 7 days and randomly divided into two groups: 200 were used for immunization and 100 were retained as controls.
statement: 鱼类适应环境7天，并随机分为两组：200条用于免疫接种，100条保留作为对照。
text_zh: 鱼类适应环境7天，并随机分为两组：200条用于免疫接种，100条保留作为对照。
text_en: Fish were acclimated to the environment for 7 days and randomly divided into two groups: 200 fish for immunization and 100 retained as controls.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 28 ± 2.0°C.
statement: 水温维持在28±2.0°C。
text_zh: 水温维持在28±2.0°C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 28 ± 2.0°C.

quote: because immersion vaccination has numerous advantages over the injection methods including minimal pain for fish, lower labor costs and time coupled with greater operator safety especially for large numbers of small fish (2 , 3 , 18).
statement: 浸浴免疫相比注射方法具有诸多优势，包括对鱼造成的疼痛最小、降低人工成本和时间，以及提高操作人员安全性，尤其适用于大量小鱼。
text_zh: 浸浴免疫相比注射方法具有诸多优势，包括对鱼造成的疼痛最小、降低人工成本和时间，以及提高操作人员安全性，尤其适用于大量小鱼。
text_en: Bath immunization has many advantages over injection methods, including minimal pain to fish, reduced labor costs and time, and improved operator safety, especially for large numbers of small fish.
outcome: 动物福利（疼痛）与操作安全

quote: We found that the inactivated V. harveyi vaccine induced a peak mucosal antibody titer earlier than that for serum indicating a more robust mucosal immunity in response to immersion vaccination.
statement: 研究发现灭活哈维氏弧菌疫苗诱导的黏膜抗体滴度峰值早于血清，表明浸浴免疫产生了更稳健的黏膜免疫。
text_zh: 研究发现灭活哈维氏弧菌疫苗诱导的黏膜抗体滴度峰值早于血清，表明浸浴免疫产生了更稳健的黏膜免疫。
text_en: The study found that the peak mucosal antibody titer induced by the inactivated Vibrio harveyi vaccine occurred earlier than in serum, indicating that bath immunization produced more robust mucosal immunity.
intervention: Immersion with inactivated V. harveyi vaccine
intervention_record: 灭活哈维氏弧菌疫苗浸泡免疫

quote: The protection after 1 week immunization was Table 3 Challenge of no-immunized fish with different concentrations of suspension V. harveyi administered by injection (number of deaths/number of trials).
statement: 免疫后1周的保护效果见表3，表3展示了未免疫鱼通过注射不同浓度哈维氏弧菌悬浮液攻毒的结果（死亡数/试验次数）。
text_zh: 免疫后1周的保护效果见表3，表3展示了未免疫鱼通过注射不同浓度哈维氏弧菌悬浮液攻毒的结果（死亡数/试验次数）。

quote: Table 4 Challenge of immunized fish with V. harveyi administered by injection.
statement: 表4展示了通过注射哈维氏弧菌对免疫鱼进行攻毒的结果。
text_zh: 表4展示了通过注射哈维氏弧菌对免疫鱼进行攻毒的结果。
text_en: Table 4 shows the results of challenge via injection with Vibrio harveyi in immunized fish.

quote: And the r value of RPS and antibody showed that the protect of vaccine is moderately linear correlation with antibody in mucus, while low linear correlation with antibody in serum (Table 5).
statement: 相对存活率(RPS)与抗体的r值显示，疫苗保护力与黏液中的抗体呈中度线性相关，而与血清中的抗体呈低度线性相关。
text_zh: 相对存活率(RPS)与抗体的r值显示，疫苗保护力与黏液中的抗体呈中度线性相关，而与血清中的抗体呈低度线性相关。
text_en: The relative percent survival (RPS) and the r value of antibodies show that vaccine protection has a moderate linear correlation with antibodies in mucus, and a low linear correlation with antibodies in serum.

quote: molecular adaptation mechanisms involved in fish intestine-liver immunity is related to soybean meal stress (40).
statement: 鱼类肠-肝免疫涉及的分子适应机制与豆粕应激有关。
text_zh: 鱼类肠-肝免疫涉及的分子适应机制与豆粕应激有关。
text_en: Molecular adaptive mechanisms involved in fish gut-liver immunity are related to soybean meal stress.

quote: We found that IgM gene expression levels in the gills were significantly increased following immunization and were much greater than for the skin mucosa for the grouper and crucian carp.
statement: 研究发现，在免疫接种后，石斑鱼和鲫鱼的鳃中IgM基因表达水平显著增加，且远高于皮肤黏膜。
text_zh: 研究发现，在免疫接种后，石斑鱼和鲫鱼的鳃中IgM基因表达水平显著增加，且远高于皮肤黏膜。
text_en: The study found that after immunization, IgM gene expression levels in the gills of grouper and crucian carp increased significantly and were much higher than those in skin mucosa.

quote: IgM mRNA levels were also higher in spleen and HK following vaccination demonstrating the importance of systemic immunity.
statement: 疫苗接种后脾脏和头肾中的IgM mRNA水平也较高，证明了系统性免疫的重要性。
text_zh: 疫苗接种后脾脏和头肾中的IgM mRNA水平也较高，证明了系统性免疫的重要性。
text_en: IgM mRNA levels in the spleen and head kidney were also higher after vaccination, demonstrating the importance of systemic immunity.

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that IgM mRNA in spleen, HK, gills and hindgut of S. chuatsi increased after intraperitoneal injection of inactivated Flavobacterium columniformis (33).
statement: 先前的研究证明，腹腔注射灭活的柱状黄杆菌后，翘嘴鲌脾脏、头肾、鳃和后肠中的IgM mRNA增加。
text_zh: 先前的研究证明，腹腔注射灭活的柱状黄杆菌后，翘嘴鲌脾脏、头肾、鳃和后肠中的IgM mRNA增加。
text_en: Previous studies have demonstrated that intraperitoneal injection of inactivated Flavobacterium columnare increased IgM mRNA in the spleen, head kidney, gills, and hindgut of Culter alburnus.

quote: For instance, the toxic effects of microcystins to zebrafish were reflected in the spleen, intestine and gills with the up-regulation of immune-related genes that demonstrates the relationship between spleen and mucosal immunity (41).
statement: 微囊藻毒素对斑马鱼的毒性作用反映在脾脏、肠道和鳃中，伴随免疫相关基因的上调，这证明了脾脏与黏膜免疫之间的关系。
text_zh: 微囊藻毒素对斑马鱼的毒性作用反映在脾脏、肠道和鳃中，伴随免疫相关基因的上调，这证明了脾脏与黏膜免疫之间的关系。
text_en: The toxic effects of microcystin on zebrafish are reflected in the spleen, intestine, and gills, accompanied by the upregulation of immune-related genes, which demonstrates the relationship between the spleen and mucosal immunity.

quote: Table 6. Frequency profiles of micronuclei induced by endosulfan alone and in combination with column eluted fractions of active P. hexandrum extracts for different time intervals to evaluate the antimutagenicity in C. carassius .
statement: 该表展示了单独使用硫丹以及硫丹与活性五棱菊提取物柱洗脱组分联合使用时，在不同时间间隔下诱导鲫鱼微核的频率分布，以评估其抗突变性。
text_zh: 该表展示了单独使用硫丹以及硫丹与活性五棱菊提取物柱洗脱组分联合使用时，在不同时间间隔下诱导鲫鱼微核的频率分布，以评估其抗突变性。
text_en: This table shows the frequency distribution of micronuclei induced in crucian carp at different time intervals when endosulfan was used alone and when endosulfan was combined with column elution fractions of active Pentadesma butyracea extract, to evaluate its antimutagenicity.
intervention_record: 植物提取物与硫丹联合暴露

statement: 在48小时暴露时间点，阴性对照组微核频率为0.23%，溶剂对照组为0.26%，而单独硫丹处理组的微核频率显著升高至3.17%。
text_zh: 在48小时暴露时间点，阴性对照组微核频率为0.23%，溶剂对照组为0.26%，而单独硫丹处理组的微核频率显著升高至3.17%。
text_en: At the 48-hour exposure time point, the micronucleus frequency was 0.23% in the negative control group and 0.26% in the solvent control group, while it increased significantly to 3.17% in the endosulfan-only treatment group.

statement: 在72小时暴露时间点，阴性对照组微核频率为0.19%，溶剂对照组为0.27%，而单独硫丹处理组的微核频率进一步升高至3.57%。
text_zh: 在72小时暴露时间点，阴性对照组微核频率为0.19%，溶剂对照组为0.27%，而单独硫丹处理组的微核频率进一步升高至3.57%。
text_en: At the 72-hour exposure time point, the micronucleus frequency was 0.19% in the negative control group and 0.27% in the solvent control group, while it further increased to 3.57% in the endosulfan-only treatment group.

quote: The RPS levels were basically the same for both fish. They both peaked in the 4 th week, remained at their peak in the 5 th week, and dropped to the level of the 2 nd week in the 6 th week, just the grouper RPS level is somewhat higher than the carp (47.4% vs. 44.4%).
statement: 两种鱼的相对保护率（RPS）基本相同，均在第4周达到峰值，在第5周保持峰值，并在第6周降至第2周的水平，仅石斑鱼的RPS略高于鲫鱼（47.4% vs. 44.4%）。
text_zh: 两种鱼的相对保护率（RPS）基本相同，均在第4周达到峰值，在第5周保持峰值，并在第6周降至第2周的水平，仅石斑鱼的RPS略高于鲫鱼（47.4% vs. 44.4%）。
text_en: The relative percent survival (RPS) of the two fish species was essentially the same, peaking at week 4, maintaining the peak at week 5, and dropping to the level of week 2 by week 6; only the RPS of grouper was slightly higher than that of crucian carp (47.4% vs. 44.4%).

quote: In spite of this, IgM expression levels for both fish were high from day 7 th to 21 st .
statement: 尽管如此，两种鱼的IgM表达水平在第7天至第21天期间均保持较高水平。
text_zh: 尽管如此，两种鱼的IgM表达水平在第7天至第21天期间均保持较高水平。
text_en: Nevertheless, IgM expression levels in both fish species remained high from day 7 to day 21.

quote: Scherer vd. (2006) yapmış oldukları çalışmada farklı hasat tekniklerinin ot sazanında (Ctenopharyngodon idella) kimyasal ve mikrobiyolojik kalitesine olan etkisini incelemiş, buzlu suya daldırma ve elektrik ile muameleden sonra buzlu suda asfiksasyon yöntemlerini inceledikleri çalışmada, hasat yönteminin raf ömrüne bir etkisinin olmadığını tespit etmişlerdir.
statement: Farklı hasat tekniklerinin (buzlu suya daldırma, elektrik şoku ve buzlu suda asfiksasyon) ot sazanının raf ömrü üzerinde etkili olmadığı belirlenmiştir.
text_en: Farklı hasat tekniklerinin (buzlu suya daldırma, elektrik şoku ve buzlu suda asfiksasyon) ot sazanının raf ömrü üzerinde etkili olmadığı belirlenmiştir.

quote: Araştırıcılar sazan balıklarını 1,0±0,5ᵒC’de 20 gün boyunca depolamışlardır. Araştırma sonuçlarına göre farklı öldürme metotları arasında depolama sonunda bir fark gözlenemediği bildirilmiştir.
statement: 1,0±0,5°C'de 20 günlük depolama sonunda farklı öldürme metotları arasında bir fark gözlenmemiştir.

quote: It is reported that the soluble extracellular products of pathogenic V. harveyi stains showed strong toxicity to crucian carp and the fibroblasts of grass carp (16), so there are soluble and insoluble antigens both in the inactivated V. harveyi vaccine.
statement: 据报道，致病性哈维氏弧菌菌株的可溶性胞外产物对鲫鱼和草鱼成纤维细胞具有强毒性，因此灭活的哈维氏弧菌疫苗中同时含有可溶性和不溶性抗原。
text_zh: 据报道，致病性哈维氏弧菌菌株的可溶性胞外产物对鲫鱼和草鱼成纤维细胞具有强毒性，因此灭活的哈维氏弧菌疫苗中同时含有可溶性和不溶性抗原。
text_en: It is reported that the soluble extracellular products of pathogenic Vibrio harveyi strains are highly toxic to crucian carp and grass carp fibroblasts, therefore inactivated Vibrio harveyi vaccines contain both soluble and insoluble antigens.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (crucian carp) 和草鱼 (grass carp)

statement: Scherer vd. (2006), farklı hasat tekniklerinin ot sazanında kimyasal ve mikrobiyolojik kaliteye etkisini incelemiştir; bu teknikler arasında buzlu suya daldırma ve elektrik uygulaması yer almaktadır.
text_en: Scherer vd. (2006), farklı hasat tekniklerinin ot sazanında kimyasal ve mikrobiyolojik kaliteye etkisini incelemiştir; bu teknikler arasında buzlu suya daldırma ve elektrik uygulaması yer almaktadır.

text_en: Farklı öldürme metotlarının C. idella'da kimyasal ve mikrobiyolojik değişimlere neden olduğu incelenmiştir.

quote: The length of both fish species did not differ significantly between the beginning and the end of the experiment, but the fish lost almost half of their weight (Fig. 5).
statement: 两种鱼类的体长在实验开始和结束之间没有显著差异，但体重几乎减少了一半。
text_zh: 两种鱼类的体长在实验开始和结束之间没有显著差异，但体重几乎减少了一半。
text_en: There was no significant difference in body length between the start and end of the experiment for both fish species, but body weight decreased by almost half.

quote: Every two weeks, water samples (1 L) were collected 30 cm below the water surface in each mesocosm for determination of chlorophyll a (Chl a), total suspended solids (TSS), inorganic suspended solids (ISS), ammonium (AN), nitrate nitrogen (NN) and total phosphorus (TP) concentrations.
statement: 每两周从每个中宇宙水面下30厘米处采集1升水样，用于测定叶绿素a、总悬浮固体、无机悬浮固体、铵态氮、硝态氮和总磷浓度。
text_zh: 每两周从每个中宇宙水面下30厘米处采集1升水样，用于测定叶绿素a、总悬浮固体、无机悬浮固体、铵态氮、硝态氮和总磷浓度。

quote: Forty crucian carp approximately one-year-old (51 ± 9.8 g) and 40 approximately two-year-old (123 ± 16.9 g) were divided into four groups (10 fish/group) each according to water temperature (16 °C and 26 °C), and sex.
statement: 鲫鱼被根据水温（16°C和26°C）和性别分为四个组，每组10条鱼。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被根据水温（16°C和26°C）和性别分为四个组，每组10条鱼。
text_en: Crucian carp were divided into four groups based on water temperature (16°C and 26°C) and sex, with 10 fish per group.

quote: Each group was maintained in a 60 L tank containing dechlorinated tap water with a constant photoperiod of 12 h light: 12 h darkness for 14 days.
statement: 每组鱼在装有脱氯自来水的60升水箱中维持14天，光照周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_zh: 每组鱼在装有脱氯自来水的60升水箱中维持14天，光照周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_en: Each group of fish was maintained for 14 days in a 60-liter tank containing dechlorinated tap water, with a light cycle of 12 hours light: 12 hours dark.

quote: Ammonium concentrations did not differ between the experimental treatments (RM-ANOVA, p= 0.667, Fig. 2d).
statement: 各实验处理组之间的铵态氮浓度没有差异。
text_zh: 各实验处理组之间的铵态氮浓度没有差异。
text_en: There was no difference in ammonium nitrogen concentration among the experimental treatment groups.

quote: We found that both species of fish decreased in weight (Rudd - 5.9 g and Prussian carp – 10.3 g on average) during the experiment.
statement: 我们发现两种鱼在实验期间体重均下降（红眼鱼平均减少5.9克，普鲁士鲤鱼平均减少10.3克）。
text_zh: 我们发现两种鱼在实验期间体重均下降（红眼鱼平均减少5.9克，普鲁士鲤鱼平均减少10.3克）。
text_en: We found that both fish species lost weight during the experiment (red-eye fish decreased by an average of 5.9 grams, Prussian carp decreased by an average of 10.3 grams).

population.species: 普鲁士鲤鱼; 红眼鱼

intervention: Farming Prussian carp and red-eye fish
intervention_record: 普鲁士鲤鱼和红眼鱼养殖

quote: the fish intestinal microbiome is one of the key determinants of fish health: bacterial microbiota may improve nutrient bioavailability and extraction from water or mud, as well as increase host tolerance of and resistance to biotic (and abiotic) stressors
statement: 鱼类肠道微生物组是决定鱼类健康的关键因素之一：细菌微生物群可能改善营养生物利用度以及从水或泥中提取营养的能力，并增加宿主对生物（和非生物）胁迫的耐受性和抵抗力。
text_zh: 鱼类肠道微生物组是决定鱼类健康的关键因素之一：细菌微生物群可能改善营养生物利用度以及从水或泥中提取营养的能力，并增加宿主对生物（和非生物）胁迫的耐受性和抵抗力。
text_en: The fish gut microbiome is one of the key factors determining fish health: bacterial microbiota may improve nutrient bioavailability and the ability to extract nutrients from water or mud, and increase host tolerance and resistance to biotic (and abiotic) stress.
outcome: 健康状况与应激耐受性

quote: Crucian carp were maintained in this enclosure for 5 months without anti‐inflammatory drugs or antimicrobials.
statement: 鲫鱼在围网中养殖了5个月，期间未使用抗炎药物或抗菌剂。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在围网中养殖了5个月，期间未使用抗炎药物或抗菌剂。
text_en: Crucian carp were farmed in cage nets for 5 months, during which no anti-inflammatory drugs or antimicrobial agents were used.
intervention_record: 不使用抗炎药或抗菌剂

quote: Fish were placed in sterile tubes and were immediately killed by freezing at −80°C.
statement: 鱼被放入无菌管中，并立即通过−80°C冷冻处死。
text_zh: 鱼被放入无菌管中，并立即通过−80°C冷冻处死。
text_en: Fish were placed in sterile tubes and immediately euthanized by freezing at −80°C.

quote: altering the microbiotas of the external environment to promote beneficial bacterial growth in the fish intestine
statement: 通过改变外部环境的微生物群可以促进鱼肠道内有益菌的生长。
text_zh: 通过改变外部环境的微生物群可以促进鱼肠道内有益菌的生长。
text_en: Modifying the microbiota of the external environment can promote the growth of beneficial bacteria in fish intestines.

quote: In November 2016, we established about one and a half acres enclosure in a freshwater lake located in Jining, Shandong, China (34°29′N, 116°36′E), and populated it with Crucian carp at a density of 200 fish per acre.
statement: 研究在湖泊中建立了约1.5英亩的围网，并以每英亩200尾的密度放养鲫鱼。
text_zh: 研究在湖泊中建立了约1.5英亩的围网，并以每英亩200尾的密度放养鲫鱼。
text_en: The study established about 1.5 acres of enclosures in a lake and stocked crucian carp at a density of 200 fish per acre.

quote: Conclui-se que a exposição aguda de C. auratus ao cloreto de sódio (NaCl) deve ser de no máximo 10 g L-1, levando à perda de desempenho e/ou mortalidade dos animais.
statement: A exposição aguda de Carassius auratus ao cloreto de sódio deve ser limitada a 10 g L-1 para evitar perda de desempenho ou mortalidade.
text_en: A exposição aguda de Carassius auratus ao cloreto de sódio deve ser limitada a 10 g L-1 para evitar perda de desempenho ou mortalidade.

quote: A exposição crônica a 5 g L-1 de NaCl promove acidemia, desequilíbrio iônico e alterações patológicas nas brânquias, por isso não é recomendado.
statement: A exposição crônica a 5 g L-1 de NaCl causa acidemia, desequilíbrio iônico e alterações patológicas nas brânquias, sendo portanto não recomendada.
text_en: A exposição crônica a 5 g L-1 de NaCl causa acidemia, desequilíbrio iônico e alterações patológicas nas brânquias, sendo portanto não recomendada.
outcome: saúde das brânquias e equilíbrio ácido-base

quote:
Amostras de sangue e brânquias
dos peixes foram coletadas e observou-se que os peixes apresentaram diminuição nas concentrações
de bicarbonato (NaHCO3) no sangue, indicando hipernatremia.
statement: Peixes submetidos à exposição crônica apresentaram diminuição nas concentrações de bicarbonato no sangue, indicando hipernatremia.
text_en: Peixes submetidos à exposição crônica apresentaram diminuição nas concentrações de bicarbonato no sangue, indicando hipernatremia.

quote: Further studies of the microbiota of aquatic environments will lead to a better understanding of fish health maintenance and assessment.
statement: 对水生环境微生物群的进一步研究将有助于更好地理解鱼类的健康维护和评估。
text_zh: 对水生环境微生物群的进一步研究将有助于更好地理解鱼类的健康维护和评估。
text_en: Further studies of the microbiota of aquatic environments will help to better understand fish health maintenance and assessment.

quote: With detailed knowledge of the interactions between the microbiotas of external and internal environments, aquaculture practices can be improved by, for example, altering the microbi
statement: 通过详细了解外部和内部环境微生物群之间的相互作用，可以通过例如改变微生物来改善水产养殖实践。
text_zh: 通过详细了解外部和内部环境微生物群之间的相互作用，可以通过例如改变微生物来改善水产养殖实践。
text_en: By gaining a detailed understanding of the interactions between external and internal environmental microbiota, aquaculture practices can be improved by, for example, altering the microbiota.

quote: which perhaps may reflect that the temperature in our experimental mesocosms varied from 14 to 17oC at night and from 17 to 23oC during day, i.e. being close to limit diapason of enzyme cellulase activity in Rudd.
statement: 这种缺乏显著负面影响的情况可能反映了实验围隔中的温度变化（夜间14-17°C，白天17-23°C）接近红眼鱼纤维素酶活性的极限范围。
text_zh: 这种缺乏显著负面影响的情况可能反映了实验围隔中的温度变化（夜间14-17°C，白天17-23°C）接近红眼鱼纤维素酶活性的极限范围。
text_en: This lack of significant negative impact may reflect that the temperature variation in the experimental enclosures (14-17°C at night, 17-23°C during the day) was close to the limit range for cellulase activity in rudd.
outcome: 消化酶活性与摄食能力

quote: Adapting to salinity changes requires extra energy to maintain iono-osmotic balance, influencing fish metabolic needs and promoting changes in respiratory responses (Honorato, Dambros, Marcondes, & Nascimento, 2014).
statement: 适应盐度变化需要额外能量来维持离子渗透平衡，这会影响鱼类的代谢需求并促进呼吸反应的变化。
text_zh: 适应盐度变化需要额外能量来维持离子渗透平衡，这会影响鱼类的代谢需求并促进呼吸反应的变化。
text_en: Adapting to salinity changes requires extra energy to maintain ion osmotic balance, which affects the metabolic demands of fish and promotes changes in respiratory responses.

quote: In the captive breeding of goldfish, the recommended concentration of NaCl is 6 g L-1, which has been used in the long-term without causing stress and loss in zootechnical performance (Luz & Santos, 2008).
statement: 在金鱼人工养殖中，推荐的NaCl浓度为6 g/L，长期使用未引起应激和生产性能损失。
text_zh: 在金鱼人工养殖中，推荐的NaCl浓度为6 g/L，长期使用未引起应激和生产性能损失。
text_en: In artificial farming of goldfish, the recommended NaCl concentration is 6 g/L; long-term use did not cause stress or loss of production performance.

quote: Exposure of freshwater fish to salinity may affect the morphological characteristics (Lisboa, Barcarolli, Sampaio, & Bianchini, 2015) of various tissues.
statement: 淡水鱼暴露于盐度可能会影响各种组织的形态特征。
text_zh: 淡水鱼暴露于盐度可能会影响各种组织的形态特征。
text_en: Exposure of freshwater fish to salinity may affect morphological characteristics of various tissues.

quote: Salinity is a major environmental factor that affects the physiology of aquatic organisms, as changes in ambient salinity can directly influence fish metabolism (Boeuf & Payan, 2001; Nordlie, 2009; Anni et al., 2016).
statement: 盐度是影响水生生物生理的主要环境因素，因为环境盐度的变化可以直接影响鱼类代谢。
text_zh: 盐度是影响水生生物生理的主要环境因素，因为环境盐度的变化可以直接影响鱼类代谢。
text_en: Salinity is a major environmental factor affecting the physiology of aquatic organisms, because changes in environmental salinity can directly affect fish metabolism.

quote: The fish were distributed into eight aquariums (30 L) with constant aeration.
statement: 鱼类被分配到八个带有持续曝气的30升水族箱中。
text_zh: 鱼类被分配到八个带有持续曝气的30升水族箱中。
text_en: Fish were assigned to eight 30-liter aquaria with continuous aeration.

quote: Feeding was administered twice a day to apparent satiety with extruded commercial feed (32% CP).
statement: 每天两次投喂挤压型商业饲料（32%粗蛋白）至表观饱食状态。
text_zh: 每天两次投喂挤压型商业饲料（32%粗蛋白）至表观饱食状态。
text_en: Extruded commercial feed (32% crude protein) was fed to apparent satiation twice daily.

quote: After blood collection, the fish were euthanized by a medullary section and the gills were removed.
statement: 采血后，通过脊髓切断术对鱼进行安乐死并取出鳃。
text_zh: 采血后，通过脊髓切断术对鱼进行安乐死并取出鳃。
text_en: After blood sampling, fish were euthanized by spinal cord transection and gills were removed.

quote: Fish subjected to concentrations of 0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, and 10 g L-1 of NaCl showed 100% survival, whereas 0% survival occurred with exposure to 15 g L-1 NaCl.
statement: 暴露于0至10 g/L NaCl浓度的鱼存活率为100%，而暴露于15 g/L NaCl的鱼存活率为0%。
text_zh: 暴露于0至10 g/L NaCl浓度的鱼存活率为100%，而暴露于15 g/L NaCl的鱼存活率为0%。
text_en: Fish exposed to NaCl concentrations of 0 to 10 g/L had a survival rate of 100%, while fish exposed to 15 g/L NaCl had a survival rate of 0%.
counterevidence: 高浓度(15 g/L)导致完全死亡

quote: Chronic exposure to 5 and 10 g L-1 NaCl altered blood pH and caused ionic imbalance.
statement: A exposição crônica a 5 e 10 g L-1 de NaCl alterou o pH sanguíneo e causou desequilíbrio iônico.
text_en: A exposição crônica a 5 e 10 g L-1 de NaCl alterou o pH sanguíneo e causou desequilíbrio iônico.

quote: Branchial lesions occurred in fish exposed to acute and chronic salinity.
statement: Lesões branquiais ocorreram em peixes expostos à salinidade aguda e crônica.
text_en: Lesões branquiais ocorreram em peixes expostos à salinidade aguda e crônica.

quote: High salinity had detrimental effects on Carassius auratus survival.
statement: A alta salinidade teve efeitos prejudiciais na sobrevivência de Carassius auratus.
text_en: A alta salinidade teve efeitos prejudiciais na sobrevivência de Carassius auratus.

quote: The survival of fish subjected to 15 g L-1 NaCl was 4 h, and 5 min at a concentration of 25 g L-1.
statement: A sobrevivência dos peixes submetidos a 15 g L-1 de NaCl foi de 4 horas, e de 5 minutos na concentração de 25 g L-1.
text_en: A sobrevivência dos peixes submetidos a 15 g L-1 de NaCl foi de 4 horas, e de 5 minutos na concentração de 25 g L-1.

quote: The mortality of fish with 15 g L-1 NaCl was 100%.
statement: A mortalidade dos peixes com 15 g L-1 de NaCl foi de 100%.
text_en: A mortalidade dos peixes com 15 g L-1 de NaCl foi de 100%.

quote: Morphological analyses of the gills showed hyperplasia of the coated cells in the interlamellar space and hypersecretion of mucus in fish exposed to 10 g L-1 of NaCl.
statement: As análises morfológicas das brânquias mostraram hiperplasia das células revestidas no espaço interlamelar e hipersecreção de muco em peixes expostos a 10 g L-1 de NaCl.
text_en: As análises morfológicas das brânquias mostraram hiperplasia das células revestidas no espaço interlamelar e hipersecreção de muco em peixes expostos a 10 g L-1 de NaCl.

quote: 20 and 25 g L-1, necrosis of the support collagen caused the cells to detach from the lamellar structure mucosa.
statement: 在20和25 g L-1浓度下，支持胶原的坏死导致细胞从鳃小片结构黏膜脱落。
text_zh: 在20和25 g L-1浓度下，支持胶原的坏死导致细胞从鳃小片结构黏膜脱落。
text_en: At concentrations of 20 and 25 g L-1, collagen-supported necrosis led to the detachment of cells from the mucosa of the lamellar structures.

quote: Blood samples and gills from the fish were collected, and it was observed that the fish showed a decrease in the concentration of bicarbonate (NaHCO3) in the blood, indicating hypernatremia.
statement: 采集了鱼的血液样本和鳃，观察到血液中碳酸氢盐（NaHCO3）浓度降低，表明存在高钠血症。
text_zh: 采集了鱼的血液样本和鳃，观察到血液中碳酸氢盐（NaHCO3）浓度降低，表明存在高钠血症。
text_en: Blood samples and gills were collected from fish, and a decrease in blood bicarbonate (NaHCO3) concentration was observed, indicating hypernatremia.

quote:
Acute exposure of C. auratus to sodium chloride (NaCl) should be at a maximum
of 10 g L-1 of NaCl, after which level there would be a loss in animal performance and/or mortality.
statement: A exposição aguda de Carassius auratus ao cloreto de sódio deve ser no máximo de 10 g L-1, pois acima desse nível há perda de desempenho e/ou mortalidade.
text_en: A exposição aguda de Carassius auratus ao cloreto de sódio deve ser no máximo de 10 g L-1, pois acima desse nível há perda de desempenho e/ou mortalidade.

quote:
Chronic
exposure to 5 g L-1 of NaCl promotes acidemia, ionic imbalance, and pathological changes in the gills; therefore, it is not recommended.
statement: A exposição crônica a 5 g L-1 de NaCl promove acidemia, desequilíbrio iônico e alterações patológicas nas brânquias, portanto não é recomendada.
text_en: A exposição crônica a 5 g L-1 de NaCl promove acidemia, desequilíbrio iônico e alterações patológicas nas brânquias, portanto não é recomendada.

quote:
As análises morfológicas das brânquias
mostraram hiperplasia das células revestidas no espaço interlamelar e hipersecreção de muco em peixes
expostos a uma concentração de 10 g L-1 de NaCl.
statement: Peixes expostos a 10 g L-1 de NaCl apresentaram hiperplasia das células revestidas no espaço interlamelar e hipersecreção de muco nas brânquias.
text_en: Peixes expostos a 10 g L-1 de NaCl apresentaram hiperplasia das células revestidas no espaço interlamelar e hipersecreção de muco nas brânquias.

quote:
Nas concentrações de 20 e 25 g L-1, observou-se que a
colágeno de suporte perdeu a estrutura das células da mucosa, alterando as lamelas secundárias.
statement: Nas concentrações de 20 e 25 g L-1 de NaCl, o colágeno de suporte perdeu a estrutura das células da mucosa, alterando as lamelas secundárias.
text_en: Nas concentrações de 20 e 25 g L-1 de NaCl, o colágeno de suporte perdeu a estrutura das células da mucosa, alterando as lamelas secundárias.

quote: In husbandry practices, saline water is commonly used to reduce handling and transportation stress in freshwater species (Mirghaed & Ghelichpour, 2019) and for treatment of certain diseases (Smith, Kane, & Popper, 2003; Moyses et al., 2015).
statement: Saline water is reported to be used in husbandry practices to reduce stress from handling and transportation in freshwater species and to treat certain diseases.
text_en: Saline water is reported to be used in husbandry practices to reduce stress from handling and transportation in freshwater species and to treat certain diseases.
outcome: estresse de manejo e transporte; tratamento de doenças

quote: Changes in environmental NaCl content challenge the physiological homeostasis and biological processes of an organism (Kültz, 2015) and can cause death (Urbina & Glover, 2015) or affect growth performance (Rahmah, Liew, Napi, & Rahmat, 2020), blood parameters (Ullah et al., 2018), plasma osmolality, respirometry responses (Nordlie, 2009), histopathology, or behavior (Abe, Dias, Cordeiro, Ramos, & Fujimoto, 2015; Honorato & Nascimento, 2016).
statement: Changes in environmental NaCl content are reported to challenge physiological homeostasis and can cause death or affect growth, blood parameters, osmolality, respiration, histopathology, and behavior.
text_en: Changes in environmental NaCl content are reported to challenge physiological homeostasis and can cause death or affect growth, blood parameters, osmolality, respiration, histopathology, and behavior.
outcome: homeostase fisiológica, mortalidade, desempenho de crescimento, parâmetros sanguíneos, resposta respiratória, histopatologia e comportamento

quote: Unsuitable NaCl dosage can lead to dehydration and hypernatremia, causing homeostasis disturbances (Mattioli et al., 2017) and susceptibility to infectious diseases (Choi, Cope, Harms, & Law, 2013).
statement: An unsuitable NaCl dosage is reported to lead to dehydration, hypernatremia, homeostasis disturbances, and increased susceptibility to infectious diseases.
text_en: An unsuitable NaCl dosage is reported to lead to dehydration, hypernatremia, homeostasis disturbances, and increased susceptibility to infectious diseases.
outcome: hidratação, equilíbrio iônico, suscetibilidade a doenças infecciosas

quote: Despite the negative effects of salinity, some reports have shown growth improvement in seawater-reared freshwater fish under suitable salinity ranges (Sparks et al., 2003).
statement: Some reports indicate that freshwater fish reared in seawater show improved growth when kept within suitable salinity ranges.
text_en: Some reports indicate that freshwater fish reared in seawater show improved growth when kept within suitable salinity ranges.

quote: Carassius auratus tolerated acute salinity transfer between 0 and 10 g L−1 without gill lesions.
statement: 金鱼（Carassius auratus）在0至10 g/L之间的急性盐度转移中耐受良好，且未出现鳃部病变。
text_zh: 金鱼（Carassius auratus）在0至10 g/L之间的急性盐度转移中耐受良好，且未出现鳃部病变。
text_en: Goldfish (Carassius auratus) tolerated acute salinity transfer between 0 and 10 g/L well, with no gill lesions observed.

quote: Chronic tolerance to 5 g L-1 promotes acid base imbalance and ionic imbalance (increase in NaCl and a decrease in blood K+).
statement: 对5 g/L盐度的慢性耐受会导致酸碱失衡和离子失衡（NaCl增加及血液K+减少）。
text_zh: 对5 g/L盐度的慢性耐受会导致酸碱失衡和离子失衡（NaCl增加及血液K+减少）。
text_en: Chronic tolerance to a salinity of 5 g/L leads to acid-base imbalance and ion imbalance (increased NaCl and decreased blood K+).
outcome: 生理稳态/酸碱与离子平衡

quote: Fish exposed to NaCl became lethargic, with increased mucus production and altered opercular beats.
statement: 暴露于NaCl的鱼变得迟钝，粘液分泌增加，鳃盖搏动改变。
text_zh: 暴露于NaCl的鱼变得迟钝，粘液分泌增加，鳃盖搏动改变。
text_en: Fish exposed to NaCl became sluggish, with increased mucus secretion and altered opercular beating.

quote: In addition, a reduction in food consumption was observed in fish subjected to 5 g L-1 NaCl.
statement: 此外，观察到暴露于5 g L-1 NaCl的鱼的摄食量减少。
text_zh: 此外，观察到暴露于5 g L-1 NaCl的鱼的摄食量减少。
text_en: In addition, a reduction in feed intake was observed in fish exposed to 5 g L-1 NaCl.

quote: The survival rate was 100% for the control group and 75% for the group exposed to 5 g L-1 NaCl.
statement: 对照组的存活率为100%，而暴露于5 g L-1 NaCl的组为75%。
text_zh: 对照组的存活率为100%，而暴露于5 g L-1 NaCl的组为75%。
text_en: The survival rate of the control group was 100%, while that of the group exposed to 5 g L-1 NaCl was 75%.

quote: The chronic tolerance of C. auratus promoted metabolic acidosis, as evidenced by the decrease in blood bicarbonate concentrations.
statement: C. auratus的慢性耐受性促进了代谢性酸中毒，表现为血液碳酸氢盐浓度降低。
text_zh: C. auratus的慢性耐受性促进了代谢性酸中毒，表现为血液碳酸氢盐浓度降低。
text_en: Chronic tolerance of C. auratus promoted metabolic acidosis, manifested as decreased blood bicarbonate concentration.

quote: With respect to the respiratory parameters, there was an increase in oxygen pressure, and consequently, in the saturation of O2 (Table 1).
statement: 关于呼吸参数，氧分压增加，从而导致O2饱和度增加（表1）。
text_zh: 关于呼吸参数，氧分压增加，从而导致O2饱和度增加（表1）。
text_en: Regarding respiratory parameters, oxygen partial pressure increased, leading to an increase in O2 saturation (Table 1).

quote: Blood sodium and chloride concentrations increased by 5% and 25%, respectively, showing hypernatremia and hyperchloremia (Table 1).
statement: 血钠和氯浓度分别增加了5%和25%，显示高钠血症和高氯血症（表1）。
text_zh: 血钠和氯浓度分别增加了5%和25%，显示高钠血症和高氯血症（表1）。
text_en: Serum sodium and chloride concentrations increased by 5% and 25%, respectively, indicating hypernatremia and hyperchloremia (Table 1).

quote: The blood potassium concentration decreased by 66% in comparison to the control group, which is typical of hypotassemia.
statement: 与对照组相比，血钾浓度降低了66%，这是低钾血症的典型表现。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，血钾浓度降低了66%，这是低钾血症的典型表现。
text_en: Compared to the control group, blood potassium concentration decreased by 66%, which is a typical manifestation of hypokalemia.

quote: The survival time in 15 g L-1 of NaCl was four h, and approximately five min in concentrations of 20 and 25 g L-1.
statement: 在15 g L-1 NaCl中的存活时间为4小时，而在20和25 g L-1浓度中约为5分钟。
text_zh: 在15 g L-1 NaCl中的存活时间为4小时，而在20和25 g L-1浓度中约为5分钟。
text_en: The survival time was 4 hours in 15 g L-1 NaCl, while it was about 5 minutes at concentrations of 20 and 25 g L-1.

quote: The LD50 occurred at 11.52 g L-1 of NaCl (R2 = 0.802)
statement: 半数致死量（LD50）发生在11.52 g L-1的NaCl浓度下。
text_zh: 半数致死量（LD50）发生在11.52 g L-1的NaCl浓度下。
text_en: The median lethal dose (LD50) occurred at a NaCl concentration of 11.52 g L-1.

quote: Fish subjected to 15, 20, and 25 g L-1 NaCl showed changes in behavior characterized by agitation and erratic swimming.
statement: 暴露于15、20和25 g L-1 NaCl的鱼表现出以躁动和异常游泳为特征的行为变化。
text_zh: 暴露于15、20和25 g L-1 NaCl的鱼表现出以躁动和异常游泳为特征的行为变化。
text_en: Fish exposed to 15, 20 and 25 g L-1 NaCl exhibited behavioral changes characterized by agitation and abnormal swimming.

quote: Fish subjected to water salinity up to 15 g L-1 exhibited diffuse detachment of the brachial epithelium, associated with mild cellular hyperplasia in the interlamellar space (Figure 1A).
statement: 暴露于高达15 g L-1水盐度的鱼表现出鳃上皮弥漫性脱落，并伴有层间空间轻度细胞增生。
text_zh: 暴露于高达15 g L-1水盐度的鱼表现出鳃上皮弥漫性脱落，并伴有层间空间轻度细胞增生。
text_en: Fish exposed to water salinity up to 15 g L-1 showed diffuse sloughing of the gill epithelium, accompanied by mild cellular proliferation in the interlamellar spaces.

quote: At concentrations of 20 and 25 g L-1, slight morphological changes were observed, such as moderate vascular congestion of the secondary lamellae (Figure 1 B).
statement: 在20和25 g L-1浓度下，观察到轻微的形态变化，如次级鳃叶中度血管充血。
text_zh: 在20和25 g L-1浓度下，观察到轻微的形态变化，如次级鳃叶中度血管充血。
text_en: At concentrations of 20 and 25 g L-1, slight morphological changes were observed, such as moderate vascular congestion in the secondary gill lamellae.

quote: Blood parameters of Carassius auratus after 21 days of storage in water salinity
statement: 金鱼在水盐度中储存21天后的血液参数。
text_zh: 金鱼在水盐度中储存21天后的血液参数。
text_en: Blood parameters of goldfish after 21 days in water salinity.

quote: LD50 was expressed as the concentration of NaCl resulting in the death of 50% of the fish.
statement: 半数致死量（LD50）被定义为导致50%鱼类死亡的NaCl浓度。
text_zh: 半数致死量（LD50）被定义为导致50%鱼类死亡的NaCl浓度。
text_en: The median lethal dose (LD50) is defined as the NaCl concentration that causes 50% mortality in fish.

quote: The fish were kept in a 1 L aquarium, maintained at a temperature of 27 °C and photoperiod of 12 h of light, with constant aeration.
statement: 鱼被饲养在1升水族箱中，维持27°C温度和12小时光照的光周期，并持续充氧。
text_zh: 鱼被饲养在1升水族箱中，维持27°C温度和12小时光照的光周期，并持续充氧。
text_en: Fish were kept in 1-liter aquaria, maintained at a temperature of 27°C and a photoperiod of 12 hours of light, with continuous aeration.

quote: The waste from the tank was siphoned, and water was replaced with the same salinity for each treatment.
statement: 通过虹吸去除水箱中的废物，并为每个处理组更换相同盐度的水。
text_zh: 通过虹吸去除水箱中的废物，并为每个处理组更换相同盐度的水。
text_en: Waste was removed from the tanks by siphoning, and water of the same salinity was replaced for each treatment group.

quote: After saline exposure and death verification, nine fish from each NaCl concentration were removed, and the gills of these animals were extracted for histological analysis.
statement: 在盐水暴露和死亡验证后，从每个NaCl浓度中取出九条鱼，提取其鳃进行组织学分析。
text_zh: 在盐水暴露和死亡验证后，从每个NaCl浓度中取出九条鱼，提取其鳃进行组织学分析。
text_en: After saltwater exposure and mortality verification, nine fish were removed from each NaCl concentration, and their gills were extracted for histological analysis.

quote: Chronic tolerance was assessed using the results of the acute test. Seventy-two specimens of Carassius auratus were exposed to 5 g L-1 of NaCl for 21 days.
statement: 利用急性试验结果评估慢性耐受性。七十二尾金鱼（Carassius auratus）暴露在5 g L-1的NaCl中21天。
text_zh: 利用急性试验结果评估慢性耐受性。七十二尾金鱼（Carassius auratus）暴露在5 g L-1的NaCl中21天。
text_en: Chronic tolerance was assessed using acute test results. Seventy-two goldfish (Carassius auratus) were exposed to 5 g L-1 NaCl for 21 days.

quote: The waste was removed and water was added with the same salinity each day.
statement: 每天移除废物并添加具有相同盐度的水。
text_zh: 每天移除废物并添加具有相同盐度的水。
text_en: Waste is removed daily and water with the same salinity is added.

quote: The experimental design was completely randomized with two treatments and four replicates (nine fish per aquarium).
statement: 实验设计为完全随机化，包含两个处理和四个重复（每个水族箱九条鱼）。
text_zh: 实验设计为完全随机化，包含两个处理和四个重复（每个水族箱九条鱼）。
text_en: The experimental design was completely randomized, including two treatments and four replicates (nine fish per aquarium).

quote: Similar observations were made when fish were subjected to stress, such as hyperplasia at the tip of the filaments and in the tilapia lamellae in fish confined to a reduced space (Reis, Sant’Ana, Azevedo, Merlini, & Araújo, 2009); proliferation of epithelial cells in the gill filaments and lamellae, lamellar fusi
statement: 当鱼类受到压力时（如被限制在缩小空间内的罗非鱼），也观察到了类似的现象，例如丝状体尖端和罗非鱼小片中的增生；鳃丝和小片中上皮细胞的增殖，小片融合
text_zh: 当鱼类受到压力时（如被限制在缩小空间内的罗非鱼），也观察到了类似的现象，例如丝状体尖端和罗非鱼小片中的增生；鳃丝和小片中上皮细胞的增殖，小片融合
text_en: Similar phenomena were also observed when fish were stressed (such as tilapia confined to reduced space), for example, hyperplasia at the tips of filaments and in tilapia lamellae; proliferation of epithelial cells in gill filaments and lamellae, and fusion of lamellae.

quote: proliferation of epithelial cells in the gill filaments and lamellae, lamellar fusion, and mucosal cell hyperplasia in juvenile brown trout exposed to heavy metals and pesticides (Schwaiger et al., 1997)
statement: 文献报道，暴露于重金属和农药的幼年褐鳟出现鳃丝和鳃小片上皮细胞增殖、鳃小片融合及黏膜细胞增生。
text_zh: 文献报道，暴露于重金属和农药的幼年褐鳟出现鳃丝和鳃小片上皮细胞增殖、鳃小片融合及黏膜细胞增生。
text_en: Literature reports that juvenile brown trout exposed to heavy metals and pesticides exhibit proliferation of epithelial cells in gill filaments and lamellae, fusion of gill lamellae, and hyperplasia of mucous cells.

quote: urban pollution in Danio rerio from contaminated rivers (Fracácio et al., 2003)
statement: 文献报道，来自受污染河流的城市污染导致斑马鱼出现相关变化。
text_zh: 文献报道，来自受污染河流的城市污染导致斑马鱼出现相关变化。
text_en: Literature reports that urban pollution from contaminated rivers caused related changes in zebrafish.

quote: Exposure of the fish to different salinity levels is often reflected by morphological alterations ... and cell structure modifications
statement: 鱼类暴露于不同盐度水平通常反映为形态改变和细胞结构修饰。
text_zh: 鱼类暴露于不同盐度水平通常反映为形态改变和细胞结构修饰。
text_en: Fish exposure to different salinity levels is usually reflected in morphological changes and cellular structural modifications.

quote: Treatment with 5 g L-1 of NaCl for 21 days. (A) Presence of lamella venous congestion (arrow). HE, 200x. Bar = 50µm. (B) Presence of moderate venous congestion in primary lamella (asterisks) including secondary lamellae (arrowhead). 400x, HE. Bar = 20µm.
statement: 本研究中，用5 g/L NaCl处理21天后，观察到鳃小片静脉充血以及初级和次级鳃小片中度的静脉充血。
text_zh: 本研究中，用5 g/L NaCl处理21天后，观察到鳃小片静脉充血以及初级和次级鳃小片中度的静脉充血。
text_en: In this study, after treatment with 5 g/L NaCl for 21 days, venous congestion of the gill lamellae and moderate venous congestion in the primary and secondary gill lamellae were observed.

quote: the absence of lesions in animals exposed to concentrations up to 15 g L-1 is justified by the rapid evolution of the process, without the development of structural changes visible under microscopy.
statement: 暴露于高达15 g/L浓度的动物未出现病变，这归因于过程演变迅速，未在显微镜下形成可见的结构变化。
text_zh: 暴露于高达15 g/L浓度的动物未出现病变，这归因于过程演变迅速，未在显微镜下形成可见的结构变化。
text_en: Animals exposed to concentrations up to 15 g/L did not show lesions, which was attributed to the rapid evolution of the process, resulting in no visible structural changes under microscopy.

quote: These histopathological injuries damage the morphological-functional integrity of the gill, reducing its efficiency in performing physiological functions (Henares, Cruz, Gomes, Pitelli, & Machado, 2008).
statement: 组织病理学损伤损害鳃的形态功能完整性，降低其执行生理功能的效率。
text_zh: 组织病理学损伤损害鳃的形态功能完整性，降低其执行生理功能的效率。
text_en: Histopathological damage impairs the morphological and functional integrity of the gills, reducing their efficiency in performing physiological functions.
outcome: 鳃部结构与功能完整性

quote: Chronic tolerance to 5 g L-1 of NaCl in C. auratus promoted alterations in the structure of the gills with hypersecretion of mucus and displacement of the epithelium proliferation of chloride cells, edema, telangiectasia (Figure 2A), and the proliferation of mucosal cells (Figure 2B).
statement: 对5 g L-1 NaCl的慢性耐受导致C. auratus鳃结构改变，包括粘液过度分泌、上皮位移、氯细胞增殖、水肿、毛细血管扩张以及粘膜细胞增殖。
text_zh: 对5 g L-1 NaCl的慢性耐受导致C. auratus鳃结构改变，包括粘液过度分泌、上皮位移、氯细胞增殖、水肿、毛细血管扩张以及粘膜细胞增殖。
text_en: Chronic tolerance to 5 g L-1 NaCl led to changes in the gill structure of C. auratus, including excessive mucus secretion, epithelial displacement, chloride cell proliferation, edema, capillary dilation, and mucosal cell proliferation.

quote: The lethal nature of NaCl to freshwater fish is an expected effect due to the loss of water to the environment that is characteristic of stenohaline fishes (Fashina-Bombata & Busari, 2003).
statement: NaCl对淡水鱼的致死性是由于狭盐性鱼类特有的向环境失水所致，这是一种预期效应。
text_zh: NaCl对淡水鱼的致死性是由于狭盐性鱼类特有的向环境失水所致，这是一种预期效应。
text_en: The lethality of NaCl to freshwater fish is due to water loss to the environment, which is specific to stenohaline fish; this is an expected effect.

quote: Qualitative analysis revealed that the aquatic environment influenced the tissue morphology of the gills.
statement: 定性分析显示，水生环境影响了鳃的组织形态。
text_zh: 定性分析显示，水生环境影响了鳃的组织形态。
text_en: Qualitative analysis showed that the aquatic environment affected the histomorphology of the gills.

quote:
The objectives of this study were
to evaluate the sub-chronic sensitivity of
Carassius auratus to different concentrations
of NaCl and to assess the possible changes
in the gills, ionic regulation, and respiratory
metabolism after chronic exposure.
statement: 本研究旨在评估金鱼对不同浓度氯化钠的亚慢性敏感性，并评估慢性暴露后鳃、离子调节和呼吸代谢的可能变化。
text_zh: 本研究旨在评估金鱼对不同浓度氯化钠的亚慢性敏感性，并评估慢性暴露后鳃、离子调节和呼吸代谢的可能变化。
text_en: This study aims to evaluate the subchronic sensitivity of goldfish to different concentrations of sodium chloride, and to assess possible changes in gills, ion regulation, and respiratory metabolism after chronic exposure.
outcome: 鳃、离子调节和呼吸代谢

quote: The water quality was documented.
statement: 水质已被记录。
text_zh: 水质已被记录。
text_en: Water quality has been recorded.

quote:
A completely randomized design was
carried out with nine differences salinities
of (Zuanon, Salaro, Veras, Tavares, & Chaves,
2009) NaCl in water (0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, 10, 15,
20, and 25 g L-1).
statement: 采用完全随机设计，设置了九种不同的水中NaCl盐度（0、0.5、1.0、2.5、5.0、10、15、20和25 g L-1）。
text_zh: 采用完全随机设计，设置了九种不同的水中NaCl盐度（0、0.5、1.0、2.5、5.0、10、15、20和25 g L-1）。
text_en: A completely randomized design was used, with nine different water NaCl salinities (0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, 10, 15, 20 and 25 g L-1).

quote:
For this test, three repetitions were
used, containing three fish per experimental
unit, for 96 h to measure the LD50.
statement: 该测试使用了三个重复，每个实验单元包含三条鱼，持续96小时以测量LD50。
text_zh: 该测试使用了三个重复，每个实验单元包含三条鱼，持续96小时以测量LD50。
text_en: The test used three replicates, with each experimental unit containing three fish, for a duration of 96 hours to measure LD50.

quote: The main component of ionic imbalance is the increase in membrane permeability, which favors the loss of NaCl to the external and less concentrated environment by the concentration gradient (Diniz & Honorato, 2012).
statement: 离子失衡的主要成分是膜通透性增加，这有利于通过浓度梯度将NaCl流失到外部浓度较低的环境中。
text_zh: 离子失衡的主要成分是膜通透性增加，这有利于通过浓度梯度将NaCl流失到外部浓度较低的环境中。
text_en: The main component of ion imbalance is increased membrane permeability, which favors the loss of NaCl to the external environment with lower concentration via the concentration gradient.

quote: The fish in this study that were exposed to chronic salinity exhibited hypernatremia, which may be related to the decrease in membrane permeability, altering the ionic exchange.
statement: 本研究中暴露于慢性盐度的鱼表现出高钠血症，这可能与膜通透性降低、改变离子交换有关。
text_zh: 本研究中暴露于慢性盐度的鱼表现出高钠血症，这可能与膜通透性降低、改变离子交换有关。
text_en: Fish exposed to chronic salinity in this study exhibited hypernatremia, which may be related to decreased membrane permeability and altered ion exchange.
outcome: 血液离子水平（高钠血症）

quote: However, this is an indication that the fish are hyperventilating to eliminate sodium through the gills.
statement: 然而，这表明鱼正在过度换气以通过鳃排出钠。
text_zh: 然而，这表明鱼正在过度换气以通过鳃排出钠。
text_en: However, this indicates that the fish are hyperventilating to excrete sodium through their gills.

quote: Hypernatremia evolves with hyperosmolality and causes cell dehydration, which can lead to changes in the central nervous system.
statement: 高钠血症伴随高渗透压发展并导致细胞脱水，这可能引起中枢神经系统的变化。
text_zh: 高钠血症伴随高渗透压发展并导致细胞脱水，这可能引起中枢神经系统的变化。
text_en: Hypernatremia develops with hyperosmolality and leads to cellular dehydration, which may cause changes in the central nervous system.

quote: CUR has been shown to inhibit deltamethrin-induced oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in Northern snakehead (Channa argus) by regulating the Nrf2 signaling pathway [ 7 ].
statement: 姜黄素通过调节Nrf2信号通路抑制北方黑鱼中由溴氰菊酯诱导的氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 姜黄素通过调节Nrf2信号通路抑制北方黑鱼中由溴氰菊酯诱导的氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_en: Curcumin inhibits deltamethrin-induced oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in northern snakehead by regulating the Nrf2 signaling pathway.

quote: Ammonia toxicity has been the main cause of growth inhibition, oxidative stress, and reduced immunity in crucian carp (Carassius auratus) [ 19 ].
statement: 氨毒性是鲫鱼生长抑制、氧化应激和免疫力下降的主要原因。
text_zh: 氨毒性是鲫鱼生长抑制、氧化应激和免疫力下降的主要原因。
text_en: Ammonia toxicity is the main cause of growth inhibition, oxidative stress and decreased immunity in crucian carp.

quote: We hypothesized that CUR could regulate oxidative stress and ferroptosis to ameliorate the adverse effects of acute ammonia exposure on gibel carp.
statement: 作者假设姜黄素可以通过调节氧化应激和铁死亡来缓解急性氨暴露对银鲫的不利影响。
text_zh: 作者假设姜黄素可以通过调节氧化应激和铁死亡来缓解急性氨暴露对银鲫的不利影响。
text_en: The authors hypothesize that curcumin can alleviate the adverse effects of acute ammonia exposure on gibel carp by regulating oxidative stress and ferroptosis.
outcome: 氨胁迫下的氧化应激与铁死亡

quote: dietary supplementation with CUR significantly increased feeding rate (FR) (p p > 0.05).
statement: 膳食补充姜黄素显著提高了摄食率（注：原文标注p>0.05，通常表示不显著，此处保留原文陈述）。
text_zh: 膳食补充姜黄素显著提高了摄食率（注：原文标注p>0.05，通常表示不显著，此处保留原文陈述）。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with curcumin significantly increased the feeding rate (Note: The original text marks p>0.05, which usually indicates non-significance; the original statement is retained here).

quote: However, liver injury and ferroptosis in fish induced by ammonia could be attenuated by CUR.
statement: 姜黄素（CUR）可以减轻氨诱导的鱼类肝损伤和铁死亡。
text_zh: 姜黄素（CUR）可以减轻氨诱导的鱼类肝损伤和铁死亡。
text_en: Curcumin (CUR) can alleviate ammonia-induced liver injury and ferroptosis in fish.

quote: Collectively, these findings demonstrate that CUR ameliorates oxidative stress and attenuates ammonia stress-induced ferroptosis.
statement: 研究结果表明，姜黄素能改善氧化应激并减轻氨胁迫诱导的铁死亡。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，姜黄素能改善氧化应激并减轻氨胁迫诱导的铁死亡。
text_en: The results indicate that curcumin can improve oxidative stress and alleviate ferroptosis induced by ammonia stress.

quote: This study provides a new perspective on potential preventive strategies against ammonia stress in gibel carp by dietary CUR.
statement: 该研究为通过膳食姜黄素预防银鲫氨胁迫提供了新的视角。
text_zh: 该研究为通过膳食姜黄素预防银鲫氨胁迫提供了新的视角。
text_en: This study provides a new perspective on preventing ammonia stress in gibel carp through dietary curcumin.

quote: High concentrations of ammonia are toxic to fish, as ammonia can produce excessive accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), thereby inducing oxidative stress in fish and causing an imbalance in the metabolic system, including damage to liver function, and eventually leading to massive fish mortality [ 1 ].
statement: 高浓度氨对鱼有毒，因为它会导致活性氧过度积累，从而诱发氧化应激、代谢系统失衡及肝功能损伤，最终导致大量鱼类死亡。
text_zh: 高浓度氨对鱼有毒，因为它会导致活性氧过度积累，从而诱发氧化应激、代谢系统失衡及肝功能损伤，最终导致大量鱼类死亡。
text_en: High concentrations of ammonia are toxic to fish because they cause excessive accumulation of reactive oxygen species, thereby inducing oxidative stress, metabolic system imbalance, and liver function damage, ultimately leading to mass fish mortality.
outcome: 氨毒性、氧化应激与死亡率

quote: Increasing the activity of antioxidant enzymes, such as superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione peroxidase (GPx), is one of the most important defense strategies to eliminate ROS in fish [ 3 ].
statement: 增加超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）等抗氧化酶的活性是消除鱼类体内活性氧最重要的防御策略之一。
text_zh: 增加超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）等抗氧化酶的活性是消除鱼类体内活性氧最重要的防御策略之一。
text_en: Increasing the activity of antioxidant enzymes such as superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione peroxidase (GPx) is one of the most important defense strategies for eliminating reactive oxygen species in fish.

quote: Plasma levels of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) are considered sensitive biological indicators for assessing liver damage in fish due to environmental stress [ 4 ].
statement: 血浆天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）水平被认为是评估环境胁迫引起的鱼类肝损伤的敏感生物指标。
text_zh: 血浆天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）水平被认为是评估环境胁迫引起的鱼类肝损伤的敏感生物指标。
text_en: Plasma aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels are considered sensitive biomarkers for assessing fish liver damage caused by environmental stress.

quote: In common carp (Cyprinus carpio), SOD, GPx, AST, and ALT levels were increased by ammonia exposure [ 5 ].
statement: 在鲤鱼中，氨暴露导致SOD、GPx、AST和ALT水平升高。
text_zh: 在鲤鱼中，氨暴露导致SOD、GPx、AST和ALT水平升高。
text_en: In carp, ammonia exposure led to increased levels of SOD, GPx, AST and ALT.

quote: the gill tissue structure in the first three groups was intact, with a large number of gill lamellae neatly and tightly arranged on the gill filaments and without visible damage.
statement: 前三个组的鳃组织结构完整，鳃小片排列整齐紧密且无可见损伤。
text_zh: 前三个组的鳃组织结构完整，鳃小片排列整齐紧密且无可见损伤。
text_en: The gill tissue structure of the first three groups was intact, with gill lamellae arranged neatly and tightly without visible damage.
outcome: 组织健康/鳃部结构完整性

quote: However, the branchial tissue of the TAN group showed pathological changes, with partial branchial hypotrophy and flattening and shortening in the visual field.
statement: TAN组的鳃组织表现出病理变化，包括部分鳃萎缩以及视野中的扁平化和缩短。
text_zh: TAN组的鳃组织表现出病理变化，包括部分鳃萎缩以及视野中的扁平化和缩短。
text_en: The gill tissue of the TAN group showed pathological changes, including partial gill atrophy as well as flattening and shortening in the field of view.
outcome: 组织健康/鳃部病理损伤

quote: By contrast, the liver tissue of the TAN group showed abnormalities, some hepatocytes were slightly hypertrophic, with the nucleus disappearing or fragmenting, and the cytoplasm was vacuolated.
statement: 相比之下，TAN组的肝组织显示出异常，部分肝细胞轻微肥大，核消失或碎裂，细胞质空泡化。
text_zh: 相比之下，TAN组的肝组织显示出异常，部分肝细胞轻微肥大，核消失或碎裂，细胞质空泡化。
text_en: In contrast, the liver tissue of the TAN group showed abnormalities, with slight hypertrophy of some hepatocytes, nuclear disappearance or fragmentation, and cytoplasmic vacuolation.
outcome: 组织健康/肝脏病理损伤

quote: The liver injury in the TAN + CUR group was effectively relieved after ingesting CUR feed.
statement: 摄入CUR饲料后，TAN + CUR组的肝损伤得到有效缓解。
text_zh: 摄入CUR饲料后，TAN + CUR组的肝损伤得到有效缓解。
text_en: After consuming CUR feed, liver damage in the TAN + CUR group was effectively alleviated.
outcome: 组织健康/肝脏损伤修复

quote: In gibel carp, the mRNA levels of nrf2 , heme oxygenase-1 (ho-1), catalase (cat), and sod were significantly decreased in the TAN group compared with the CON group
statement: 在银鲫中，与CON组相比，TAN组的nrf2、血红素加氧酶-1 (ho-1)、过氧化氢酶 (cat)和超氧化物歧化酶 (sod)的mRNA水平显著降低。
text_zh: 在银鲫中，与CON组相比，TAN组的nrf2、血红素加氧酶-1 (ho-1)、过氧化氢酶 (cat)和超氧化物歧化酶 (sod)的mRNA水平显著降低。
text_en: In silver crucian carp, compared with the CON group, mRNA levels of nrf2, heme oxygenase-1 (ho-1), catalase (cat) and superoxide dismutase (sod) were significantly decreased in the TAN group.
outcome: 氧化应激反应/Nrf2信号通路

quote: After ingestion of the CUR diet, mRNA levels of nrf2 , nqo-1 , cat , and sod were significantly increased in the TAN + CUR group.
statement: 摄入CUR饮食后，TAN + CUR组的nrf2、nqo-1、cat和sod的mRNA水平显著增加。
text_zh: 摄入CUR饮食后，TAN + CUR组的nrf2、nqo-1、cat和sod的mRNA水平显著增加。
text_en: After ingestion of the CUR diet, mRNA levels of nrf2, nqo-1, cat and sod in the TAN + CUR group increased significantly.
outcome: 氧化应激反应/Nrf2信号通路激活

quote: Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) results showed that compared with the CON group, the liver tissue in the TAN group exhibited mitochondrial outer membrane rupture and mitochondrial atrophy accompanied by reduction or disappearance of mitochondrial ridges and increased membrane density.
statement: 透射电子显微镜(TEM)结果显示，与CON组相比，TAN组的肝组织表现出线粒体外膜破裂和线粒体萎缩，伴随线粒体嵴减少或消失以及膜密度增加。
text_zh: 透射电子显微镜(TEM)结果显示，与CON组相比，TAN组的肝组织表现出线粒体外膜破裂和线粒体萎缩，伴随线粒体嵴减少或消失以及膜密度增加。
text_en: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) results showed that, compared with the CON group, liver tissue in the TAN group exhibited mitochondrial outer membrane rupture and mitochondrial atrophy, accompanied by reduced or absent mitochondrial cristae and increased membrane density.
outcome: 细胞器健康/线粒体损伤

quote: The alterations observed in the gills of fish exposed to salinity resulted in changes to the gas exchange process.
statement: 暴露于盐度的鱼类鳃部观察到的变化导致气体交换过程发生改变。
text_zh: 暴露于盐度的鱼类鳃部观察到的变化导致气体交换过程发生改变。
text_en: Changes observed in the gills of fish exposed to salinity led to alterations in the gas exchange process.

quote: The increase in mucous cells causes hypersecretion of mucus, which can lead to protection of the tissue structure in adverse environmental situations and exposure to possible toxicants (Mazon, Cerqueira, & Fernandes, 2002; Henares et al., 2008).
statement: 粘液细胞增加导致粘液过度分泌，这可能在不利环境条件下保护组织结构并应对可能的有毒物质暴露。
text_zh: 粘液细胞增加导致粘液过度分泌，这可能在不利环境条件下保护组织结构并应对可能的有毒物质暴露。
text_en: An increase in mucous cells leads to excessive mucus secretion, which may protect tissue structure and respond to potential exposure to toxic substances under adverse environmental conditions.

quote: Exposure of fish to chronic salinity tolerance revealed lethargy with increased mucous production and changes in opercular beats, as well as a decreased food consumption.
statement: 鱼类对慢性盐度耐受性的暴露显示出嗜睡、粘液产生增加和鳃盖搏动变化，以及食物摄入量减少。
text_zh: 鱼类对慢性盐度耐受性的暴露显示出嗜睡、粘液产生增加和鳃盖搏动变化，以及食物摄入量减少。
text_en: Exposure to chronic salinity tolerance in fish showed lethargy, increased mucus production and changes in opercular beating, as well as reduced food intake.

quote: The low feed intake of the fish exposed to salinity can be attributed to manifestations such as irritation, agitation, and lethargy (Farshadian, Salati, Keyvanshokooh, & Pasha-Zanoosi, 2018).
statement: 暴露于盐度的鱼类低摄食量可归因于刺激、躁动和嗜睡等表现。
text_zh: 暴露于盐度的鱼类低摄食量可归因于刺激、躁动和嗜睡等表现。
text_en: Low feed intake in fish exposed to salinity may be attributed to manifestations such as stimulation, restlessness and lethargy.

quote: Survival reflected the level of dehydration of freshwater fish when exposed to saline water (Fashina-Bombata & Busari, 2003).
statement: 存活率反映了淡水鱼在暴露于咸水时的脱水水平。
text_zh: 存活率反映了淡水鱼在暴露于咸水时的脱水水平。
text_en: Survival rate reflects the dehydration level of freshwater fish when exposed to saltwater.

quote: The prolonged exposure of the fish to NaCl caused alterations to the gaseous exchanges, which promoted an increase in the concentration of H+.
statement: 鱼类长时间暴露于NaCl导致气体交换改变，从而促进H+浓度增加。
text_zh: 鱼类长时间暴露于NaCl导致气体交换改变，从而促进H+浓度增加。
text_en: Prolonged exposure of fish to NaCl leads to changes in gas exchange, thereby promoting an increase in H+ concentration.

quote: When the concentration of H+ in the blood increases (pH < 7.40), acidemia occurs, which may be secondary to metabolic or respiratory acidosis.
statement: 当血液中H+浓度增加（pH < 7.40）时，会发生酸血症，这可能是代谢性或呼吸性酸中毒的继发结果。
text_zh: 当血液中H+浓度增加（pH < 7.40）时，会发生酸血症，这可能是代谢性或呼吸性酸中毒的继发结果。
text_en: Acidemia occurs when the H+ concentration in the blood increases (pH < 7.40), which may be a secondary result of metabolic or respiratory acidosis.

quote: This study investigated the potential role of curcumin (CUR) in preventing oxidative stress and ferroptosis induced by ammonia exposure in gibel carp.
statement: 本研究调查了姜黄素在预防氨暴露诱导的鲫鱼氧化应激和铁死亡中的潜在作用。
text_zh: 本研究调查了姜黄素在预防氨暴露诱导的鲫鱼氧化应激和铁死亡中的潜在作用。
text_en: This study investigated the potential role of curcumin in preventing ammonia exposure-induced oxidative stress and ferroptosis in crucian carp.

quote: Experimental fish (initial weight: 11.22 ± 0.10 g, n = 150) were fed diets supplemented with or without 0.5% CUR for 56 days, followed by a 24 h ammonia (32.5 mg/L) exposure.
statement: 实验鱼（初始体重：11.22 ± 0.10 g，n = 150）饲喂添加或不添加0.5%姜黄素的日粮56天，随后进行24小时氨（32.5 mg/L）暴露。
text_zh: 实验鱼（初始体重：11.22 ± 0.10 g，n = 150）饲喂添加或不添加0.5%姜黄素的日粮56天，随后进行24小时氨（32.5 mg/L）暴露。
text_en: Experimental fish (initial body weight: 11.22 ± 0.10 g, n = 150) were fed diets with or without 0.5% curcumin supplementation for 56 days, followed by a 24-hour ammonia exposure (32.5 mg/L).

quote: Liver damages (aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), adenosine deaminase (ADA), and alkaline phosphatase (ALP)) and oxidative stress enzyme activities (reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA); and the content of antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and glutathione peroxidase (GPx)) were induced by ammonia stress.
statement: 氨胁迫诱导了肝脏损伤指标（AST、ALT、ADA和ALP）以及氧化应激酶活性（ROS、MDA；以及抗氧化能力含量T-AOC、SOD和GPx）的变化。
text_zh: 氨胁迫诱导了肝脏损伤指标（AST、ALT、ADA和ALP）以及氧化应激酶活性（ROS、MDA；以及抗氧化能力含量T-AOC、SOD和GPx）的变化。
text_en: Ammonia stress induced changes in liver injury indicators (AST, ALT, ADA and ALP) as well as oxidative stress enzyme activities (ROS, MDA; and antioxidant capacity contents T-AOC, SOD and GPx).

quote: The antioxidant capacity was decreased, as indicated by inhibited gene expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (nrf2), heme oxygenase-1 (ho-1), catalase (cat), and sod .
statement: 抗氧化能力下降，表现为核因子E2相关因子2 (nrf2)、血红素加氧酶-1 (ho-1)、过氧化氢酶 (cat) 和超氧化物歧化酶 (sod) 基因表达受到抑制。
text_zh: 抗氧化能力下降，表现为核因子E2相关因子2 (nrf2)、血红素加氧酶-1 (ho-1)、过氧化氢酶 (cat) 和超氧化物歧化酶 (sod) 基因表达受到抑制。
text_en: Antioxidant capacity decreased, manifested as suppressed gene expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), catalase (CAT), and superoxide dismutase (SOD).

quote: Ferroptosis was induced by ammonia stress, as suggested by upregulated mRNA levels of nuclear receptor coactivator 4 (ncoa4), transferrin receptor 1 (tfr1), and iron-responsive element-binding protein 2 (ireb2), and downregulated expression of glutathione peroxidase 4 (gpx4), ferroportin (fpn), and ferritin heavy chain 1 (fth1).
statement: 氨胁迫诱导了铁死亡，表现为核受体共激活因子4 (ncoa4)、转铁蛋白受体1 (tfr1) 和铁反应元件结合蛋白2 (ireb2) 的mRNA水平上调，以及谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4 (gpx4)、铁输出蛋白 (fpn) 和铁蛋白重链1 (fth1) 的表达下调。
text_zh: 氨胁迫诱导了铁死亡，表现为核受体共激活因子4 (ncoa4)、转铁蛋白受体1 (tfr1) 和铁反应元件结合蛋白2 (ireb2) 的mRNA水平上调，以及谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4 (gpx4)、铁输出蛋白 (fpn) 和铁蛋白重链1 (fth1) 的表达下调。

quote: In addition, both mRNA and protein levels of ferroptosis markers acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4) and prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 (PTGS2) were upregulated, while cystine/glutamate antiporter (SLC7A11) was downregulated.
statement: 此外，铁死亡标志物长链酰基辅酶A合成酶家族成员4 (ACSL4) 和前列腺内过氧化物合酶2 (PTGS2) 的mRNA和蛋白水平均上调，而胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向转运体 (SLC7A11) 下调。
text_zh: 此外，铁死亡标志物长链酰基辅酶A合成酶家族成员4 (ACSL4) 和前列腺内过氧化物合酶2 (PTGS2) 的mRNA和蛋白水平均上调，而胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向转运体 (SLC7A11) 下调。
text_en: In addition, the mRNA and protein levels of ferroptosis markers long-chain acyl-CoA synthetase family member 4 (ACSL4) and prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 (PTGS2) were upregulated, while cystine/glutamate antiporter (SLC7A11) was downregulated.

quote: the addition of CUR significantly reduced the levels of the abovementioned indexes
statement: 添加姜黄素显著降低了上述指标（血浆葡萄糖、皮质醇、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和碱性磷酸酶）的水平。
text_zh: 添加姜黄素显著降低了上述指标（血浆葡萄糖、皮质醇、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和碱性磷酸酶）的水平。
text_en: Adding curcumin significantly reduced the levels of the above indicators (plasma glucose, cortisol, aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, adenosine deaminase and alkaline phosphatase).

quote: No significant difference was found in plasma lactic acid (LD) content among the treatment groups
statement: 各处理组之间血浆乳酸含量无显著差异。
text_zh: 各处理组之间血浆乳酸含量无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in plasma lactate content among the treatment groups.

quote: compared with the total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) group, the total ammonia nitrogen + curcumin (TAN + CUR) group significantly had decreased ROS, MDA, and AST contents and increased T-AOC
statement: 与总氨氮组相比，总氨氮加姜黄素组的活性氧、丙二醛和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶含量显著降低，总抗氧化能力显著增加。
text_zh: 与总氨氮组相比，总氨氮加姜黄素组的活性氧、丙二醛和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶含量显著降低，总抗氧化能力显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the total ammonia nitrogen group, the total ammonia nitrogen plus curcumin group had significantly decreased levels of reactive oxygen species, malondialdehyde, and aspartate aminotransferase, and a significantly increased total antioxidant capacity.

quote: No changes were found in SOD, GPx, or ALT activities
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶或丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性未发现变化。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶或丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性未发现变化。
text_en: No changes were found in the activity of superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase, or alanine aminotransferase.

quote: The gill histological results showed that the gill lamellae in the CON, CUR, and TAN + CUR groups were in significantly better condition than those in the TAN group
statement: 鳃组织学结果显示，对照组、姜黄素组和总氨氮加姜黄素组的鳃小片状况显著优于总氨氮组。
text_zh: 鳃组织学结果显示，对照组、姜黄素组和总氨氮加姜黄素组的鳃小片状况显著优于总氨氮组。
text_en: Histological results of gill tissue showed that the condition of gill lamellae in the control group, curcumin group, and total ammonia nitrogen plus curcumin group was significantly better than that in the total ammonia nitrogen group.

quote: Furthermore, acute ammonia stress decreased hepatic antioxidant capacity (T-AOC and SOD, GPx) in the gibel carp, while the opposite result was observed for the CUR treatment.
statement: 此外，急性氨胁迫降低了鲫鱼的肝脏抗氧化能力（T-AOC和SOD，GPx），而CUR处理观察到了相反的结果。
text_zh: 此外，急性氨胁迫降低了鲫鱼的肝脏抗氧化能力（T-AOC和SOD，GPx），而CUR处理观察到了相反的结果。
text_en: In addition, acute ammonia stress reduced the liver antioxidant capacity (T-AOC and SOD, GPx) of crucian carp, while CUR treatment showed the opposite result.

quote: the opposite result was observed for the CUR treatment
statement: 姜黄素（CUR）处理产生了与急性氨胁迫相反的结果，即提高了抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 姜黄素（CUR）处理产生了与急性氨胁迫相反的结果，即提高了抗氧化能力。
text_en: Curcumin (CUR) treatment produced results opposite to acute ammonia stress, namely enhancing antioxidant capacity.

quote: liver ROS and MDA levels were significantly stimulated by acute ammonia stress
statement: 急性氨胁迫显著刺激了肝脏活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平升高。
text_zh: 急性氨胁迫显著刺激了肝脏活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平升高。
text_en: Acute ammonia stress significantly stimulated the increase in liver reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels.

quote: mRNA levels of the Nrf2 pathway and its downstream antioxidant key genes (nrf2 , ho-1 , cat , and sod) were significantly decreased in the TAN group
statement: 在总氨氮（TAN）组中，Nrf2通路及其下游关键抗氧化基因（nrf2, ho-1, cat, sod）的mRNA水平显著降低。
text_zh: 在总氨氮（TAN）组中，Nrf2通路及其下游关键抗氧化基因（nrf2, ho-1, cat, sod）的mRNA水平显著降低。
text_en: In the total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) group, mRNA levels of the Nrf2 pathway and its downstream key antioxidant genes (nrf2, ho-1, cat, sod) were significantly decreased.

quote: suggesting that acute ammonia stress disturbed the antioxidant balance in the fish and induced oxidative stress
statement: 这表明急性氨胁迫扰乱了鱼类的抗氧化平衡并诱导了氧化应激。
text_zh: 这表明急性氨胁迫扰乱了鱼类的抗氧化平衡并诱导了氧化应激。
text_en: This indicates that acute ammonia stress disrupted the antioxidant balance in fish and induced oxidative stress.

quote: CUR enhanced antioxidant capacity by activating the Nrf2 pathway in the TAN + CUR group
statement: 在TAN + CUR组中，姜黄素通过激活Nrf2通路增强了抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 在TAN + CUR组中，姜黄素通过激活Nrf2通路增强了抗氧化能力。
text_en: In the TAN + CUR group, curcumin enhanced antioxidant capacity by activating the Nrf2 pathway.

quote: In line with this, CUR significantly enhanced the anti-apoptotic capacity in gibel carp, as indicated by inhibited apoptotic signals in the liver induced by acute ammonia stress.
statement: 姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制急性氨应激诱导的肝脏凋亡信号，显著增强了银鲫的抗凋亡能力。
text_zh: 姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制急性氨应激诱导的肝脏凋亡信号，显著增强了银鲫的抗凋亡能力。
text_en: Curcumin (CUR) significantly enhanced the anti-apoptotic capacity of gibel carp by inhibiting liver apoptosis signaling induced by acute ammonia stress.

quote: Ammonia stress also significantly induced the mRNA levels of nuclear receptor coactivator 4 (ncoa4), transferrin receptor 1 (tfr1), acsl4 , and ptgs2 and decreased the mRNA levels of cellular tumor antigen (p53), glutathione peroxidase 4 (gpx4), ferroportin (fpn), and ferritin heavy chain 1 (fth1) compared with the CON group.
statement: 与对照组相比，氨胁迫显著诱导了核受体共激活因子4 (ncoa4)、转铁蛋白受体1 (tfr1)、acsl4和ptgs2的mRNA水平，并降低了细胞肿瘤抗原(p53)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4 (gpx4)、铁输出蛋白(fpn)和铁蛋白重链1 (fth1)的mRNA水平。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，氨胁迫显著诱导了核受体共激活因子4 (ncoa4)、转铁蛋白受体1 (tfr1)、acsl4和ptgs2的mRNA水平，并降低了细胞肿瘤抗原(p53)、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4 (gpx4)、铁输出蛋白(fpn)和铁蛋白重链1 (fth1)的mRNA水平。
text_en: Compared with the control group, ammonia stress significantly induced mRNA levels of nuclear receptor coactivator 4 (ncoa4), transferrin receptor 1 (tfr1), acsl4 and ptgs2, and decreased mRNA levels of cellular tumor antigen (p53), glutathione peroxidase 4 (gpx4), ferroportin (fpn) and ferritin heavy chain 1 (fth1).

quote: The opposite changes were observed in the TAN + CUR group (Figure 5 B,C).
statement: 在TAN + CUR组中观察到相反的变化。
text_zh: 在TAN + CUR组中观察到相反的变化。
text_en: Opposite changes were observed in the TAN + CUR group.

quote: Meanwhile, the protein expression levels of ACSL4 and PTGS2 were significantly increased, and SLC7A11 protein expression was significantly decreased in the TAN group compared with the CON group, while contrasting changes were observed in the TAN + CUR group (Figure 5 D,E).
statement: 同时，与对照组相比，TAN组中ACSL4和PTGS2的蛋白表达水平显著升高，而SLC7A11蛋白表达显著降低，而在TAN + CUR组中观察到相反的变化。
text_zh: 同时，与对照组相比，TAN组中ACSL4和PTGS2的蛋白表达水平显著升高，而SLC7A11蛋白表达显著降低，而在TAN + CUR组中观察到相反的变化。
text_en: Meanwhile, compared with the control group, protein expression levels of ACSL4 and PTGS2 were significantly increased in the TAN group, while SLC7A11 protein expression was significantly decreased; conversely, opposite changes were observed in the TAN + CUR group.

quote: the apoptosis rate of hepatocytes in the TAN group was significantly higher than that in the CON group, whereas the apoptosis rate in the TAN + CUR group was significantly lower than that in the TAN group.
statement: TAN组肝细胞的凋亡率显著高于CON组，而TAN + CUR组的凋亡率显著低于TAN组。
text_zh: TAN组肝细胞的凋亡率显著高于CON组，而TAN + CUR组的凋亡率显著低于TAN组。
text_en: The apoptosis rate of hepatocytes in the TAN group was significantly higher than that in the CON group, while the apoptosis rate in the TAN + CUR group was significantly lower than that in the TAN group.

quote: As a high concentration of ammonia in the water could lead to tissue damage and high mortality in aquaculture species
statement: 水中高浓度的氨会导致养殖物种的组织损伤和高死亡率。
text_zh: 水中高浓度的氨会导致养殖物种的组织损伤和高死亡率。
text_en: High concentrations of ammonia in water cause tissue damage and high mortality in farmed species.

quote: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), a key transcription factor in regulating genes associated with oxidative damage, was also induced by ammonia [ 6 , 7 ].
statement: 核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2），一种调节与氧化损伤相关基因的关键转录因子，也被氨诱导。
text_zh: 核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2），一种调节与氧化损伤相关基因的关键转录因子，也被氨诱导。
text_en: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), a key transcription factor that regulates genes related to oxidative damage, is also induced by ammonia.

quote: It has been reported that inhibition of ferroptosis by reducing the formation of lipid peroxidation products in the body through nutritional pathways may provide a potential protective strategy against related pathologies [ 15 ].
statement: 据报道，通过营养途径减少体内脂质过氧化产物的形成以抑制铁死亡，可能为相关病理提供潜在的保护策略。
text_zh: 据报道，通过营养途径减少体内脂质过氧化产物的形成以抑制铁死亡，可能为相关病理提供潜在的保护策略。
text_en: It is reported that reducing the formation of lipid peroxidation products in the body via nutritional pathways to inhibit ferroptosis may provide a potential protective strategy for related pathologies.

quote: At present, it is unclear whether ammonia stress induces hepatocyte death through induced ferroptosis.
statement: 目前尚不清楚氨胁迫是否通过诱导铁死亡引起肝细胞死亡。
text_zh: 目前尚不清楚氨胁迫是否通过诱导铁死亡引起肝细胞死亡。
text_en: It is currently unclear whether ammonia stress causes hepatocyte death by inducing ferroptosis.

quote: Thus, CUR affected the process of liver injury in gibel carp through the inhibition of the ferroptosis pathway.
statement: 姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制铁死亡途径影响鲫鱼的肝损伤过程。
text_zh: 姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制铁死亡途径影响鲫鱼的肝损伤过程。
text_en: Curcumin (CUR) affects the liver injury process in crucian carp by inhibiting the ferroptosis pathway.

quote: In our study, the mRNA levels of acsl4 and ptgs2 and the protein expression levels of ACSL4 and PTGS2 were significantly increased, and the protein expression of SLC7A11 was significantly decreased in the TAN group compared with the CON group.
statement: 与对照组相比，总氨氮（TAN）组的acsl4和ptgs2的mRNA水平以及ACSL4和PTGS2的蛋白表达水平显著升高，而SLC7A11的蛋白表达显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，总氨氮（TAN）组的acsl4和ptgs2的mRNA水平以及ACSL4和PTGS2的蛋白表达水平显著升高，而SLC7A11的蛋白表达显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, mRNA levels of acsl4 and ptgs2 and protein expression levels of ACSL4 and PTGS2 were significantly increased in the total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) group, while SLC7A11 protein expression was significantly decreased.
outcome: 氧化应激/铁死亡标志物

quote: Similarly, the fluorescence intensity of PTGS2 and ACSL4 increased significantly, and the opposite change was observed in SLC7A11 in gibel carp exposed to acute ammonia stress.
statement: 在急性氨胁迫下的鲫鱼中，PTGS2和ACSL4的荧光强度显著增加，而SLC7A11则观察到相反的变化。
text_zh: 在急性氨胁迫下的鲫鱼中，PTGS2和ACSL4的荧光强度显著增加，而SLC7A11则观察到相反的变化。
text_en: In crucian carp under acute ammonia stress, the fluorescence intensity of PTGS2 and ACSL4 increased significantly, while the opposite change was observed for SLC7A11.
outcome: 氧化应激/铁死亡标志物

quote: Taken together, data related to gene expression levels, protein expression levels, and fluorescence intensity in the TAN + CUR group suggested that CUR alleviates liver injury by inhibiting ferroptosis.
statement: 综合基因表达、蛋白表达和荧光强度的数据表明，姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制铁死亡来缓解肝损伤。
text_zh: 综合基因表达、蛋白表达和荧光强度的数据表明，姜黄素（CUR）通过抑制铁死亡来缓解肝损伤。
text_en: Integrated data on gene expression, protein expression, and fluorescence intensity indicate that curcumin (CUR) alleviates liver injury by inhibiting ferroptosis.

quote: The ﬁ sh were killed by slurry ice and gutted under sterile conditions.
statement: 鱼被冰浆杀死并在无菌条件下去除内脏。
text_zh: 鱼被冰浆杀死并在无菌条件下去除内脏。
text_en: Fish were killed with ice slurry and eviscerated under sterile conditions.

quote: However, there may be chances of bacterial cross-contamination of ﬁ sh during the gutting procedure.
statement: The gutting procedure carries a risk of bacterial cross-contamination of the fish.
text_en: The gutting procedure carries a risk of bacterial cross-contamination of the fish.

quote: In the present study, ferroptosis was induced in the TAN group as reflected by mitochondrial atrophy, reduction or disappearance of cristae, and increased membrane density.
statement: 在本研究中，TAN组（总可吸收氮/氨应激组）诱导了铁死亡，表现为线粒体萎缩、嵴减少或消失以及膜密度增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，TAN组（总可吸收氮/氨应激组）诱导了铁死亡，表现为线粒体萎缩、嵴减少或消失以及膜密度增加。
text_en: In this study, the TAN group (total absorbable nitrogen/ammonia stress group) induced ferroptosis, manifested as mitochondrial shrinkage, reduced or absent cristae, and increased membrane density.

quote: However, ferroptosis was significantly inhibited in the TAN + CUR group, as indicated by normal mitochondrial morphology and size.
statement: 然而，在TAN + CUR组中，铁死亡被显著抑制，表现为正常的线粒体形态和大小。
text_zh: 然而，在TAN + CUR组中，铁死亡被显著抑制，表现为正常的线粒体形态和大小。
text_en: However, ferroptosis was significantly inhibited in the TAN + CUR group, as evidenced by normal mitochondrial morphology and size.
outcome: 线粒体完整性/铁死亡抑制

quote: A significant increase in the mRNA levels of hepatic ncoa4 and tfr1 and a significant decrease in the mRNA levels of p53 , gpx4 , fpn , and fth1 were induced by ammonia stress, indicating that hepatic ferroptosis was triggered by stimulating iron uptake and reducing iron storage, eventually leading to liver injury in gibel carp, similar to the effects in yellow catfish [ 26 ].
statement: 氨应激导致肝脏ncoa4和tfr1 mRNA水平显著升高，以及p53、gpx4、fpn和fth1 mRNA水平显著降低，表明氨应激通过刺激铁摄取和减少铁储存触发了肝脏铁死亡，最终导致银鲫肝损伤。
text_zh: 氨应激导致肝脏ncoa4和tfr1 mRNA水平显著升高，以及p53、gpx4、fpn和fth1 mRNA水平显著降低，表明氨应激通过刺激铁摄取和减少铁储存触发了肝脏铁死亡，最终导致银鲫肝损伤。
text_en: Ammonia stress caused a significant increase in hepatic ncoa4 and tfr1 mRNA levels, and a significant decrease in p53, gpx4, fpn, and fth1 mRNA levels, indicating that ammonia stress triggered hepatic ferroptosis by stimulating iron uptake and reducing iron storage, ultimately leading to liver injury in Carassius gibelio.
outcome: 基因表达/铁稳态/肝损伤

quote: The levels of COR, GLU, LD, ALT, AST, ADA, and ALP in plasma; the activity of MDA; and the content of T-AOC, SOD, and GPx in the liver were determined with commercial kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute (Nanjing, China).
statement: 血浆中的皮质醇、葡萄糖、乳酸脱氢酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和碱性磷酸酶水平，以及肝脏中的丙二醛活性和总抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶含量均使用南京建成生物工程研究所的试剂盒进行测定。
text_zh: 血浆中的皮质醇、葡萄糖、乳酸脱氢酶、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、腺苷脱氨酶和碱性磷酸酶水平，以及肝脏中的丙二醛活性和总抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶含量均使用南京建成生物工程研究所的试剂盒进行测定。
text_en: The levels of cortisol, glucose, lactate dehydrogenase, alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, adenosine deaminase, and alkaline phosphatase in plasma, as well as the malondialdehyde activity and total antioxidant capacity, superoxide dismutase, and glutathione peroxidase content in the liver, were all determined using kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute.

quote: The level of ROS in the liver was measured with an enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) kit (Wuhan MSK Biological Technology Co., Ltd., Wuhan, China).
statement: 肝脏中的活性氧水平使用武汉MSK生物科技有限公司的酶联免疫吸附测定试剂盒进行测量。
text_zh: 肝脏中的活性氧水平使用武汉MSK生物科技有限公司的酶联免疫吸附测定试剂盒进行测量。
text_en: Reactive oxygen species levels in the liver were measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kits from Wuhan MSK Biotechnology Co., Ltd.

quote: A TUNEL assay was employed on liver tissue samples fixed by paraformaldehyde (4%) and embedded in paraffin... The sections were stained with DAPI and observed under a microscope. Image-Pro Plus 4.1 software was used for analysis.
statement: 对多聚甲醛固定并石蜡包埋的肝组织样本进行了TUNEL测定，切片经DAPI染色后在显微镜下观察，并使用Image-Pro Plus 4.1软件进行分析。
text_zh: 对多聚甲醛固定并石蜡包埋的肝组织样本进行了TUNEL测定，切片经DAPI染色后在显微镜下观察，并使用Image-Pro Plus 4.1软件进行分析。
text_en: TUNEL assay was performed on liver tissue samples fixed with paraformaldehyde and embedded in paraffin. Sections were stained with DAPI, observed under a microscope, and analyzed using Image-Pro Plus 4.1 software.

quote: CUR was hypothesized to attenuate oxidative stress and ferroptosis induced by ammonia in gibel carp.
statement: 假设姜黄素（CUR）能减轻银鲫由氨诱导的氧化应激和铁死亡。
text_zh: 假设姜黄素（CUR）能减轻银鲫由氨诱导的氧化应激和铁死亡。
text_en: Assume that curcumin (CUR) can alleviate ammonia-induced oxidative stress and ferroptosis in gibel carp.

quote: In the present study, dietary supplementation of CUR had no significant effect on SGR or FE in fish.
statement: 在本研究中，膳食补充姜黄素对鱼类的特定生长率（SGR）或饲料效率（FE）没有显著影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，膳食补充姜黄素对鱼类的特定生长率（SGR）或饲料效率（FE）没有显著影响。
text_en: In this study, dietary curcumin supplementation had no significant effect on the specific growth rate (SGR) or feed efficiency (FE) of fish.

quote: Similarly, dietary supplementation with 393.67 mg/kg CUR promoted growth in grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 21 ].
statement: 同样，膳食补充393.67 mg/kg的姜黄素促进了草鱼（Ctenopharyngodon idella）的生长。
text_zh: 同样，膳食补充393.67 mg/kg的姜黄素促进了草鱼（Ctenopharyngodon idella）的生长。
text_en: Similarly, dietary supplementation with 393.67 mg/kg curcumin promoted the growth of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella).

quote: Ammonia stress stimulated the degeneration of carp gill tissue and the infiltration of inflammatory cells, with pronounced pyknosis of liver tissue and the presence of inflammatory cells around degenerated pancreatic cells [ 22 ].
statement: 氨胁迫刺激了鲤鱼鳃组织的退化和炎症细胞的浸润，并伴有明显的肝组织固缩以及退化胰腺细胞周围存在炎症细胞。
text_zh: 氨胁迫刺激了鲤鱼鳃组织的退化和炎症细胞的浸润，并伴有明显的肝组织固缩以及退化胰腺细胞周围存在炎症细胞。
text_en: Ammonia stress stimulated degeneration and inflammatory cell infiltration in the gill tissue of carp, accompanied by obvious shrinkage of liver tissue and the presence of inflammatory cells around degenerated pancreatic cells.

quote: In the present study, compared with the CON group, the liver tissue was abnormal, some hepatocytes were slightly hypertrophic, and the cytoplasm was vacuolated.
statement: 在本研究中，与对照组相比，肝脏组织异常，部分肝细胞轻微肥大，细胞质出现空泡化。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与对照组相比，肝脏组织异常，部分肝细胞轻微肥大，细胞质出现空泡化。
text_en: In this study, compared with the control group, liver tissue abnormalities were observed, including slight hypertrophy of some hepatocytes and cytoplasmic vacuolation.

quote: Similarly, the gill tissue structure of the gibel carp in the TAN group was damaged, and some gill fragments were atrophied.
statement: 同样，TAN组银鲫的鳃组织结构受损，部分鳃片段萎缩。
text_zh: 同样，TAN组银鲫的鳃组织结构受损，部分鳃片段萎缩。
